versions.changelog:
tiktok-app-marketing v1.0.0

- Initial release automating TikTok slideshow marketing for apps/products.
- Features competitor research, AI image generation, text overlay, posting via Postiz, analytics tracking, and iterative optimization.
- Supports cross-posting to Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Threads, and more.
- Includes a user onboarding flow guiding account warmup and marketing setup.
- Optional integration with RevenueCat for conversion and subscriber analytics.
